mandate: C356 — test the cross-sectional intraday MULTISCALE ENTROPY (MSE) x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|. Multiscale Entropy metric over fixed intrinsic window W=64 bars ending at bar t, coarse-graining scales tau in {1,2,4,8,16,32}, embedding dimension m=2, tolerance r=0.25 (z-score units at each scale): for each tau, coarse-grain y^(tau)[k]=mean(X[k*tau:(k+1)*tau]), standardize z^(tau), compute SampEn^(tau)=ln(B_m^(tau))-ln(A_m^(tau)); mse_slope[t]=OLS slope of SampEn^(tau) vs log(tau) (>=3 finite pts); mse_area[t]=trapezoidal area under SampEn^(tau) vs tau. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (mse_slope_dev, mse_area_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements (t<W=64, <3 finite scales).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=64 bars ending at t: for each tau in {1,2,4,8,16,32} coarse-grain y^(tau)[k]=mean(X[k*tau:(k+1)*tau]), N_tau=W//tau; standardize z^(tau)=(y^(tau)-mean(y^(tau)))/std(y^(tau)); SampEn^(tau)=ln(B_m^(tau))-ln(A_m^(tau)) with m=2, B_m^(tau)=# ordered pairs i!=j with max|T_m[i]-T_m[j]|<r, A_m^(tau)=# ordered pairs i!=j with max|T_{m+1}[i]-T_{m+1}[j]|<r; mse_slope[t]=OLS slope of SampEn^(tau) vs log(tau) over scales with finite SampEn (>=3 pts); mse_area[t]=trapezoidal area under SampEn^(tau) vs tau.
methodology.signals: mse_slope/mse_area over fixed W=64; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.mse_invariance_note: SampEn uses Chebyshev tolerance-based template matching on the z-scored coarse-grained series; both B_m and A_m are window-internal, so SampEn is invariant to a constant-per-bar shift and to scaling (z-scoring). Validated against brute force in tests.
